files.delete.message: It will be moved to the Recycle Bin, where you can restore it.
launch.addCommand.commandInfo: Can span several lines, run in order as if typed into a terminal. Runs in PowerShell 7 when installed, otherwise in Command Prompt. Press Ctrl+Enter to add.
terminal.info: A terminal is PowerShell (PowerShell 7 when installed) opened in a project directory, with the project's environment variables. Terminals are kept by the background service: switching pages or closing the window does not interrupt them, and output catches up when you come back. Typing exit closes the terminal. Ctrl+Shift+K clears the screen; Ctrl+C copies the selection, or interrupts the running command when nothing is selected; Ctrl-click opens a link in the browser.
settings.cli.info: Adds the installation folder to your user PATH so you can use paperplane run, logs and more in a terminal (takes effect in new terminals).
